canonical_cycle_input: For a run of order n with cycle length k dividing n, replace a(o)!=o by a(i)=floor(i/k)*k+((i+1) mod k) for i=0,...,n-1. Set max_seconds to 240 and run mace4 -n n -N n. All numeric labels are distinct carrier elements.

involution_matching_reduction.argument: A nontrivial involution a has no fixed points, and row conjugacy gives the same for b. The composition gives U=id. The maps cannot agree at any point, by maps_trivial_of_unit_and_agreement. Their two disjoint perfect matchings therefore form alternating cycles of even length at least four. At order 10 the cycle partitions are only 10 and 4+6. Fixing a to consecutive pairs and b to these two patterns covers every involutive countermodel up to relabeling.

cyclic_coordinates.statement: When a is one cycle, label a by +1 modulo n. Then the quasigroup has the form u(x)+v(y), with u,v permutations and v(0)=0. Neither u nor v is asserted additive.
